Sales include direct sales and indirect sales through sales partners, and as major counterparties, SB C&S Corp. accounts for 12.0% of total sales and Daiwabo Information System Co., Ltd. accounts for 10.8%. The domestic cloud market is expected to grow against the background of expansion of corporate IT investment, and the group is positioned as providing integration services to the kintone ecosystem.
entries.9707f43f615b29e1: Its strength is service design that even IT beginners can use with confidence, through simple operation, simple functions, and easy-to-understand design. The entire process from application to use is completed online, and by a sales method that does not provide on-site explanations and a product policy that does not provide individual customization, it keeps indirect costs down and enables low-price provision. Its safety confirmation service has a mechanism to automatically scale servers in conjunction with earthquake early warnings and other information from the Japan Meteorological Agency. The number of paid contracts has built up to 4,753 for the safety confirmation service and 14,946 for kintone integration services and others (as of the end of December 2025), and the churn rate is at a low level of 0.83%.

Because it is a stock-type business in which fees are charged according to the period of use, it regards the number of paid contracts, MRR, and churn rate as important indicators, and will expand MRR by increasing the number of paid contracts and reducing the churn rate. For its safety confirmation service, it will appeal for use across the entire supply chain; for its kintone integration services, it will increase average revenue per customer and respond to enterprise use; for NotePM, it will expand awareness and sales channels; and as issues to be addressed, it also sets out creation of new businesses and M&A.

entries.f54103ec932e72b2: This is a cloud service for confirming the safety of employees and others during disasters via mobile phones, smartphones and personal computers. It has functions for safety confirmation by simultaneous transmission, aggregation of contact status, and discussion, posting and communication of countermeasures, and can also be used for information sharing and emergency contact during emergencies such as pandemics. Servers automatically expand in linkage with earthquake alerts issued by the Japan Meteorological Agency and others, to cope with sudden surges in access during disasters. The number of paid contracts was 4,753 as of the end of December 2025. Amounts for each service are not disclosed.
